name: solve
description: Evidence-based decisions, self-contained artifacts, and clear writing. Loads only the workflow needed and preserves uncertainty, dissent, and verification limits.

interface.longDescription: Route decisions, artifacts, writing, and short answers. Consequential decisions use checked claims, a fresh blind refuter, and a separate review of the delivered result. Includes a portable HTML renderer, 32 artifact patterns, writing rules, and an evidence ledger. Uses available host tools; missing capabilities remain explicit. No server or separate model API key is required.
defaultPrompt: Help me decide. Check the evidence, challenge the recommendation, and produce a clear decision memo.
Turn this brief into a useful artifact with sources, unknowns, and a concrete next action.
Rewrite this clearly while preserving its facts, numbers, uncertainty, and my voice.
